lines.t: Thank You for the aching...
the breaking I tried to evade.
Thank You for Your silence...
to let all the lesser voices fade.
I didn’t want the empty,
I didn’t ask for barren days
but the quiet road You carved for me
became the one that saved.
I used to hate the shadows
where You stripped me of my pride;
now I find Your goodness
in the dark I tried to fight.
Thank You for the breaking
that brought me back to You.
Thank You for discomfort
that cut my idols loose.
Thank You for refining blaze
that turns my dross to gold...
I love the one You’re forging me,
less of me; more of Yours.
Thank You for the setbacks
that kept me near the flame.
Thank You for the closed doors
that spared my soul from shame.
Every “no” that broke my stride
was the boundary of Your grace...
And every stumbling step I made
Led me to Your embrace.
I blamed You for the hurting
till I learned to see the why:
Love was pruning what would kill me
so Your flow could fill my life.
Thank You for the breaking
that brought me back to You.
Thank You for discomfort
that cut my idols loose.
Thank You for refining blaze
that turns my dross to gold...
I love the one You’re forging me,
less of me: more of Yours.
You walked with me in shadows
when I thought I walked alone;
and now what is behind me
is the reason I’ve come home.
Refined; I am not ruined...
You were kind in every blow.
If this is how You love me…
then burn what’s left to go.
Thank You for the breaking
that brought me back to You.
Thank You for the discomfort
that cut my idols loose.
Thank You for the lonely road
that showed me what is true...
I love the way You’re remaking me…
I’m not afraid of You.
Thank You for the breaking.
Thank You for the pain.
Thank You for the mercy
hidden in Your flame.
